_comment: The protocol verb set, and the source of truth for it. src/gates/bd.ts ENFORCES this set, by calling `commentVerb` and comparing against these entries -- one implementation, so the guard and the parser cannot disagree. skills/orchestrate/references/message-grammar.md restates it for humans and is written by hand; test/grammar-parity.test.ts fails when the gate's set or that reference diverges from this file, in either direction, so edit here first and let the test name what else must move. A verb is what `commentVerb` in src/bd.ts yields: strip a leading run of bullet, blockquote, emphasis, tick and strikethrough markers, take the first whitespace token, strip trailing emphasis, ticks and sentence punctuation, uppercase. Case and ordinary markdown are therefore free; only the first token counts, and a multi-word verb needs its underscore. Nothing else in a comment is protocol. A non-verb is warned, not refused, and only inside an active run. Adding a verb here without a writer and a source is how a vocabulary rots: an entry sourced `inferred` is a judgement call recorded as one, not a constraint the code enforces.

writers.*: every claiming role, backed by a clause present in all six role contracts (generic.json included)
writers.unlisted: generic.json's `agent: *` fallback: any claimant with no per-role contract
writers.extension: this plugin's own code, not an agent. Named by `source.where`

source.contract: migrated exactly from the named role-contract predicate. Machine-enforced on yield
source.code: the named src file writes or parses this verb. Machine-observable, not contract-enforced
source.inferred: no contract or code constrains the writer. `where` cites the prose the narrowest defensible set was read from -- a reviewer may disagree with the set without disagreeing with the verb

_vocabulary.terminal: true when writing the verb ends the attempt it describes: the writer yields, or its claim is released. A non-terminal verb annotates work that continues

verbs.meaning: Evidence delivered, next role's label added, assignee cleared -- the node's exit contract is met.
Work cannot proceed. Written on an escalation wisp linked to the node, never stored as a bead state.

source.where: all six: escape.require. Also reviewer.json completion.verdict, researcher.json completion.answer, shepherd.json completion.disposition

verbs.meaning: Unrecoverable failure. A valid exit paired with status blocked, never a faked success.
One reviewer's verdict, written on the node its review wisp links to.
A researcher's durable answer to an escalation wisp, promoted to the linked node.
The merge bead's branch is merged and metadata.merge_sha is stamped.
The merge attempt is refused back to its origin as a fix bead.
The branch does not merge into its base. The node returns to working for a rebase; the shepherd never resolves it.
Nothing was landable this transaction. The merge slot is released and the waiter queue outlives the exit.
The role's queue is empty. Yield rather than widen the filter or invent work.

source.where: src/gates/exit.ts:230 -- the unclaimed-exit gate matches this literal to allow a claimless exit

verbs.meaning: A product-intent question only a human can settle. Pairs with a human gate on the held bead.

source.where: src/contract.ts DISPATCH_CONTRACT, Blocked clause -- injected into every worker, so narrowing below `*` is indefensible; references/lifecycle.md waiting_human row

verbs.meaning: A durable observation with no protocol consequence, such as the id of a bead discovered mid-run.

source.where: references/lifecycle.md:343 (discovered bead); references/beads-store.md:273 lists note as a material verb for any acting agent

verbs.meaning: A reversible bead-local default, provisional or accepted, carrying an objective revisit trigger.

source.where: agents/orc-architect.md:121; references/beads-store.md:44 comment contract; references/lifecycle.md:267. Narrowed to the two roles that apply implementation defaults -- a reviewer writes verdicts, a researcher writes ADVICE, a shepherd may not judge merits

verbs.meaning: The exit contract force-allowed after the bounce budget. This attempt is invalidated; repair the envelope, never continue the session.
A stranded claim was released and its bead reopened, with any surviving branch stamped.
A claimed child went silent past its threshold. No kill -- the spawner decides.
A degraded preflight or a settings deviation the run should see but not stop for.
The run objective and its status, stamped on every epic each time it changes.
